title: New passenger gets identity and audit stamps
why: Shows that the system, not the caller, sets Id, timestamps, version and the deleted flag.

steps.does: On UserCreated, register a valid passenger (Name 'Sam Lee', PassportNumber 'S1000001', Male, Age 30) without supplying Id, CreatedAt, Version or IsDeleted.

expect: The saved Passenger has a generated uuid Id, CreatedAt set to the current time, Version 0 and IsDeleted false.
